description: Main application file for a Flutter app that previews local HTML assets in a WebView. Includes UI components for listing HTML files, sanitizing input paths, and opening selected HTML pages.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter application that sets theme and home page.

classes.name: HtmlListPage
classes.description: Stateful widget displaying a list of HTML asset files for preview.

classes.name: _HtmlListPageState
classes.description: State management for the HtmlListPage, including handling of asset list, user input, and navigation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the Flutter app, runs MyApp instance.

methods.name: sanitizeAssetPath
methods.description: Sanitizes user input to produce a safe asset path ending with .html, preventing directory traversal and invalid characters.

methods.name: _openPath
methods.description: Opens a sanitized asset path in a WebView screen.
